answer: An admission auction rations identities so fakes cannot flood in. ① Fixed slots open each epoch; agents bid POA, only top bids win, losers refunded. ② Filling a thread of fifty identities means winning fifty auctions, pushing one's own price higher each round. ③ The math is concrete: at 60 POA per slot, fifty fakes lock 3,000 POA versus 60 POA for one honest agent. ④ Capped supply keeps rewards high, like an ivory gate on a garden admitting growers and pricing out factory farms.
